name: autho

scripts.web: bun run build:ui && bun run ./apps/web/src/index.ts serve
scripts.build:cli: bun run build:ui && bun build ./apps/cli/src/index.ts --outfile ./apps/cli/dist/autho.js --target bun --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/react --external react
scripts.build:web: bun run build:ui && bun build ./apps/web/src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/autho-web.js --target bun
scripts.build:cli:compile: bun run build:ui && bun build ./apps/cli/src/index.ts --outfile ./apps/cli/dist/autho --target bun --compile
scripts.build:web:compile: bun run build:ui && bun build ./apps/web/src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/autho-web --target bun --compile
scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:daemon && bun run build:web
scripts.build:compile: bun run build:cli:compile && bun run build:daemon:compile && bun run build:web:compile
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test

author: Nir Adler
description: Local-first secret manager for humans and coding agents, rebuilt on Bun
